evidenceNotes.source: dcd38348 lib/ConstPlugin.js, lib/Parser.js, and pre-existing lib/APIPlugin.js
evidenceNotes.observation: The patch adds logical-expression evaluation and branch pruning. APIPlugin registers evaluateTypeof for every replacement key even though __non_webpack_require__ has no REPLACEMENT_TYPES entry, so its runtime-sensitive typeof comparison is incorrectly evaluated as a compile-time boolean and folded.

Issue 8829 records 4.21.0 working, 4.22.0 first broken, and the guard reducing to true. The repair registers evaluateTypeof only when a replacement type exists and adds a test that changes runtime require between a function and undefined, closing the same causal boundary.
